intro.narration: Night at the waiting shed. Kuya Rico sits there, hoping his luck finally turns.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Uy, you're the new arrival! Cool. Lend me some betting money, I'll pay you Sunday, promise.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: Rico. It's been 'this Sunday' for three months now. I came here to collect.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Mang Bebot?! Why are you here, I mean, hello po! Your ledger's gotten thick, ha!

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: Exactly. Beat the kid first, then maybe you'll have something to pay with.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Ay, game! See, this is an opportunity. Just an investment, kuya. Trust the process.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Alright, you lead. You've got the three of clubs, right? Lucky you. Me, I've got nothing. Not even cash.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: You're quiet, I like that. Just like a collector. Says nothing, just takes.

intro.narration: Rico patted his pocket. Empty. He smiled anyway.

intro.speaker: kuya_rico
intro.text: Let's just relax. Even if I lose, I'll only post-date it, right Bebot?

win.narration: Your hand is empty. Rico looked at the money he did not have.

win.speaker: kuya_rico
win.text: I lost?! Wait, this isn't final, right? Is there a replay? A refund?

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: None. I'll just write this into your ledger, Rico. Add it on.

win.speaker: kuya_rico
win.text: Oh, come on! ...fine. But this is an investment, ha. I'll win it back next quarter.

win.speaker: kuya_rico
win.text: You're pretty good, kid. Let's run a sideline sometime. 50-50... 70-30... I get the 70.

lose.narration: Time is up. Rico grinned like he won a lotto he never actually joined.

lose.speaker: kuya_rico
lose.text: Yes! I won! ...which means I can finally pay you back, Bebot?

lose.speaker: mang_bebot
lose.text: No. That win is mine. Payment on your debt. Already written down.

lose.speaker: kuya_rico
lose.text: HA?! Like that? ...okay, next time you'll win it back too, kid. If you spot me a loan.

lines.speaker: kuya_rico
lines.text: Wait, I'm down to three. Can I just pay the rest in installments?

lines.speaker: mang_bebot
lines.text: Pusoy is not an installment plan, Rico!
